issue: Both games crash after defeating Taisamba 2 in boss rush
observed_boundary: Taisamba outro finishes, then legacy sync activates for Balberra on stage 610 / 0x262. Last logged function on both clients is func_802003E0_62B7C0.

native_evidence.802003E0: Waits for shared+2C1 == 1, then selects 80200434 and stores -1.0 at root+74. It does not itself identify the crashing instruction.

diagnosis_limits: No exception stack in either supplied log. Available macOS 17:23 reports belong to earlier launches. The crash itself was not reproduced by the assistant.
repairs: Native binding/readiness requires a complete boss profile: Kashiwagi or Taisamba. Balberra and D'Etoile remain native-only.
A boss-rush stage must match its selector; the previous root is rejected as soon as the stage advances.
Queued native checkpoints are revalidated at scheduler application time and discarded after a stage change; cached presentation is also fenced.
Damage authority requires current native readiness, so outgoing follower/election flags cannot freeze the next native fight.
Python root, input and visual/sound channels reject unsupported sync scopes.
The root bridge retires all input/cursor, render and audio queues on scope change or exit, even without another player-channel call.
regression_before_fix: New native test failed: queued Taisamba defeat overwrote next-stage HP (assert TU32(battle,0x60) == 1000).

checks.transition_native: Recycled root addresses, stage/selector mismatch, queued snapshots, unchanged next-boss HP/callbacks, profile retirement and re-entry.
checks.transition_bridge: Production Python bridges with recorded NUL-framed socket envelopes: staggered K/T/B/D handoffs, all channels populated before retirement, late-packet rejection, no traffic/election for later bosses, K/T re-entry.

packet_audit.scope: py and src; dynamic Impact sends are covered by channel tests

limitations: The tests verify the transition fixes and removal of unintended later-boss sync, not a fresh native two-game run or a conclusive crash-stack diagnosis. Both game processes need to restart with the updated package.
